_: Comorbid / polypharmacy topic seeds for supplementary stress-pair generation. Source: condition NAMES from PatientAgentBench's seed distribution (data/default_benchmark_seed.json, amazon-science, CC-BY-NC-4.0) - factual condition names only, no rubric or scenario text. Names normalized comma-free so the workflow's comma-separated topics param cannot split them. Owner decision 2026-08-04 COMORBID-SEED: approve (docs/decisions_20260804_pab.md). SUPPLEMENTARY convention: generate with claude-sonnet-5 (attribute_tierb's generator gate mechanically keeps it out of Tier B accounting), and add the landed stamp to _SUPPLEMENTARY_STAMPS in paired_stats_rigor.py + convergence_tracker.py BEFORE any measurement of it is collected.
selection_rule: fire_topics = one cluster per dominant organ system from the 25, keeping both medication-interaction cases (warfarin+NSAID, elderly polypharmacy)
